# do-things: Warp Drive objects

Index cards from [warpdotdev/do-things](https://github.com/warpdotdev/do-things/tree/918b9b9a648eaeea4ea227d34ba5e29362bed9db/public/objects)
(MIT, commit `918b9b9`), copied verbatim. Each card points at a public Warp Drive object.
The object itself lives in Warp Drive, not in this repo.

## Import into your Drive

1. Open the link while signed in to Warp. It opens in the Warp app.
2. Use the object's menu to duplicate it into your Personal Drive.
3. Prompts then show up in the `/` menu and in the command palette.
   Folders bring their workflows and notebooks with them.

The Free plan has a limited number of Drive objects, so import only what you will use.
The ones marked ★ fit this factory.
